findings.title: docs/img/marginal-cop.svg is stale: it plots marginal COP below the model's resistive floor
findings.claim: The committed docs/img/marginal-cop.svg is not what docs/img/make_model_figures.py regenerates from the shipped model: its curves decode to marginal COP 0.888 (buffer, gate on) and 0.956 (DHW, gate off) at -20 C, where the shipped model returns 1.0 for both.
findings.mechanism: marginal_cop() draws by calling ThermalModel.marginal_cop directly; the model gained the #928 resistive bound (max(cop,1.0) in _cop_law; max(base_cop*dhw_penalty,1.0) in compute_cop_dhw) after the figure was drawn; docs/ is INERT in tests/closure.py so nothing re-runs the generator.

evidence.contention_note: shared box, load1 11.66-13.50; count is contention-independent

perturbation.change: scale the standby-loss term in ThermalModel.simulate_dhw_step by 1.5

findings.proposed_fix_scope: re-run the generator and commit the regenerated docs/img/marginal-cop.svg; note in the docstring that this is a manual step (docs/ is INERT)
